description: Fix end-to-end SignalR realtime push: web subscribes, reverse-DNS names match, agent session transcript events have a dedicated non-domain channel, and ActivityPage Waiting list is populated.

tasks.title: Add ITranscriptEventPublisher and OnTranscriptEvent SignalR method
tasks.description: Introduce a new `ITranscriptEventPublisher` interface with a single `PublishAsync(TranscriptEnvelope)` method, define `TranscriptEnvelope` DTO (carrying the persisted row payload + the transcript event type name), extend `IEventsClient` with a new `OnTranscriptEvent(TranscriptEnvelope)` method, and add a `SignalRTranscriptEventPublisher` implementation that fans out via `IHubContext<MohistHub, IEventsClient>` filtered by `ConnectionSubscriptionRegistry` (no `IEventPublisher` / `EventBridge` involvement). Register the publisher in DI as a singleton.
acceptanceCriteria: `ITranscriptEventPublisher` interface exists with `PublishAsync(TranscriptEnvelope)`
`TranscriptEnvelope` is defined and serializes the same payload shape that the runtime event row carries
`IEventsClient` exposes `OnTranscriptEvent(TranscriptEnvelope)` alongside the existing `OnEvent`
`SignalRTranscriptEventPublisher` filters recipients via `ConnectionSubscriptionRegistry` and emits via `IHubContext.Clients.Client(connectionId).OnTranscriptEvent(...)`
DI registration added in `MohistServiceRegistration` (or equivalent) as singleton
Transcript envelopes are never routed through `IEventPublisher` or `EventBridge`
tasks.output: New ITranscriptEventPublisher + TranscriptEnvelope + SignalRTranscriptEventPublisher + IEventsClient.OnTranscriptEvent + DI registration
tasks.notes: Reuse the existing ConnectionSubscriptionRegistry hot-path; do not introduce a new registry or SignalR group.

tasks.title: Add BusType mappings for agent session lifecycle events
tasks.description: Extend `AgentSessionEventSerializer` with a `BusType` switch (or equivalent) that maps `AgentSessionStarted` / `AgentSessionActivated` / `AgentSessionCompleted` / `AgentSessionFailed` / `AgentSessionCancelled` / `AgentSessionStatusChanged` to the corresponding `EventCatalog.ReverseDns.AgentSession*` constants. Add a unit test asserting each variant resolves to the correct reverse-DNS string.
acceptanceCriteria: `AgentSessionEventSerializer.BusType` exists and returns the correct reverse-DNS string for all 6 lifecycle variants
Each variant maps to its `EventCatalog.ReverseDns.AgentSession*` constant (not a hard-coded literal)
Unit tests pass for every lifecycle variant
tasks.output: Updated AgentSessionEventSerializer.cs with BusType mappings + unit test coverage
tasks.notes: Use the existing EventCatalog.ReverseDns constants; do not invent new strings.

tasks.title: Wire AgentSessionGrain to publish lifecycle and forward transcript events
tasks.description: Update `AgentSessionGrain.AppendRuntimeEventsAsync` so that, in addition to persisting each `AgentSessionRuntimeEvents` row, it (a) forwards transcript observation rows (`coder_text_chunk`, `coder_thought_chunk`, `coder_tool_call`, `ralph_task_update`, `ralph_loop_progress`, `agent_liveness_status`, `agent_usage_update`, `agent_session_model_resolved`) to `ITranscriptEventPublisher.PublishAsync`, and (b) publishes the matching lifecycle domain event via `IEventPublisher` exactly once when the session transitions (first row → `AgentSessionStarted`; terminal `agent_session_terminal` → `Completed`/`Failed`/`Cancelled`; `agent_liveness_status` change → `StatusChanged`). Dedup must use already-persisted session state (`Status.Phase`, `Status.LastDataAt`, terminal markers) so it survives deactivation/reactivation.
acceptanceCriteria: After persisting a `coder_text_chunk` row, `ITranscriptEventPublisher.PublishAsync` is invoked with the same payload via `TranscriptEnvelope`
Same forwarding behavior applies to all 8 listed transcript event types
First persisted row for a session publishes `AgentSessionStarted` exactly once (no duplicate emits on subsequent `AppendRuntimeEventsAsync` calls)
`agent_session_terminal` with status `completed`/`failed`/`cancelled` publishes the matching lifecycle event exactly once
`agent_liveness_status` publishing `AgentSessionStatusChanged` only fires when the status actually changes (deduped by current status string)
`IEventPublisher` is never called for transcript observation event types
Dedup state survives grain deactivation/reactivation (relies on persisted session state, not transient in-memory flags)
tasks.output: Updated AgentSessionGrain.cs + supporting serializer / state-machine changes
tasks.notes: Sync await on PublishAsync is acceptable; wrap in try/catch + log so transcript push failures do not break the grain's main flow.

tasks.title: Make MohistHub OnConnectedAsync tolerate an empty initial subscription set
tasks.description: Update `MohistHub.OnConnectedAsync` so that an empty initial subscription set is the expected default for a freshly opened tab (not an error state). The first `SetSubscriptionsAsync` call from the client becomes the source of truth and populates both the in-process `ConnectionSubscriptionRegistry` and the durable `IConnectionSubscriptionGrain` together. Replay-on-reconnect continues to reapply the durable grain's stored set when present. The existing dispatcher behavior (filter by per-connection subscription set) is preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a connection without an immediate `SetSubscriptionsAsync` does not error and does not block `OnConnectedAsync`
The first `SetSubscriptionsAsync` after `OnConnectedAsync` populates both the in-process registry and the durable grain
Reconnect reapplies the stored grain set to the registry in `OnConnectedAsync`
`SetSubscriptionsAsync` remains idempotent: a second call with the same list does not duplicate or shift registry entries
Connections with an empty subscription set continue to receive no emits from the dispatcher
tasks.notes: Pair this change with the new OnTranscriptEvent method on IEventsClient so the hub exposes both event channels.

tasks.title: Populate AgentRoutes /activity waiting array from approval-gated InProgress issues
tasks.description: Update `AgentRoutes.MapGet("/activity", ...)` so that, before calling `AgentSessionQuerier.GetActivityAsync`, it queries `IssueQuerier` (or an equivalent) for the project's `IssueStatus.InProgress` issues whose current workflow stage status is `AwaitingApproval` and builds the `waiting` array of `ActivityWaitingCardDto` (the existing DTO shape). The array is passed into `GetActivityAsync` so `ActivityDto.Waiting` is no longer always empty. The response DTO shape is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/projects/{ref}/agent/activity` returns a non-empty `waiting` array when the project has an `InProgress` issue paused on an approval gate
`waiting` array is empty when no issue is in that state
`ActivityDto` shape is unchanged (no new fields)
The querier accepts the `waiting` array as a parameter and passes it through to the response DTO
tasks.output: Updated AgentRoutes.cs + AgentSessionQuerier.cs accepting the waiting array
tasks.notes: Reuse existing `ActivityWaitingCardDto` and `ActivityDto.Waiting` slots; do not invent new fields.

tasks.title: Add server spec coverage for SignalR event delivery and lifecycle dedup
tasks.description: Add spec tests under `Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Events/` covering: (a) `EventBridge` delivers a reverse-DNS event (e.g. `com.mohist.workflow.stage.started`) to a connection subscribed to the reverse-DNS name and to a connection subscribed to the legacy snake_case alias; (b) `ITranscriptEventPublisher` delivers an appended transcript event to a subscribed connection and filters out an unsubscribed connection; (c) `AgentSessionGrain.AppendRuntimeEventsAsync` publishes lifecycle domain events at most once per transition (started on first row; completed/failed/cancelled on terminal; status-changed on actual liveness change). Add a unit test that `AgentSessionEventSerializer.BusType` returns the correct reverse-DNS string for every lifecycle variant.
acceptanceCriteria: Spec test: a connection subscribed to `com.mohist.workflow.stage.started` receives the bus event through the SignalR hub
Spec test: a connection subscribed to the legacy `stage_changed` alias also receives the bus event (since reverse-DNS → legacy alias)
Spec test: `ITranscriptEventPublisher` delivers a `coder_text_chunk` envelope to a subscribed connection and skips an unsubscribed connection
Spec test: `AppendRuntimeEventsAsync` emits `AgentSessionStarted` exactly once even after repeated calls with new rows
Spec test: terminal events emit Completed/Failed/Cancelled exactly once per session transition
Spec test: `agent_liveness_status` with no actual status change does not emit `AgentSessionStatusChanged`
Unit test: `AgentSessionEventSerializer.BusType` returns the correct reverse-DNS string for all 6 lifecycle variants
tasks.output: New test files under Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Events/ and unit test for AgentSessionEventSerializer
tasks.notes: Follow the project's Specs/ layering: prefer grain + dispatcher + API integration paths over direct domain-model tests.

tasks.title: Extract canonical EVENT_TYPES list shared by LiveTaskProvider and useEventsConnection
tasks.description: Introduce a single helper / constant module (e.g. `entities/events/canonical-event-types.ts` or similar) that exports the union of every event type the Web consumes. It must include: every entry in the `EventName` union from `entities/issue/@x/events.ts`, every entry in `AGENT_DETAIL_EVENTS` from `entities/agent/model/events.ts`, the new `com.mohist.*` reverse-DNS event names (workflow stage, approval, run, issue, agent-session), and the transcript event types (`coder_text_chunk`, `coder_thought_chunk`, `coder_tool_call`, `ralph_task_update`, `ralph_loop_progress`, `agent_liveness_status`, `agent_usage_update`, `agent_session_model_resolved`). Refactor `LiveTaskProvider` and `useEventsConnection` to consume this list so the subscription set and the switch cannot drift.
acceptanceCriteria: A single `EVENT_TYPES` (or equivalent) constant module exists and is the only source of truth for the Web's event type list
The list includes every legacy snake_case name currently in `EventName` and `AGENT_DETAIL_EVENTS`
The list includes the new reverse-DNS `com.mohist.*` names for workflow stage, approval, run, issue, and agent-session events
The list includes the 8 transcript event types (so the new `OnTranscriptEvent` handler can be registered against the same subscription set)
`LiveTaskProvider` switch and `useEventsConnection` both import from the same module
tasks.output: New canonical event-types module consumed by LiveTaskProvider and useEventsConnection
tasks.notes: Re-export reverse-DNS names from the existing entity event maps so the type system stays exhaustive.

tasks.title: Make useEventsConnection invoke SetSubscriptionsAsync on start and on reconnect
tasks.description: Update `useEventsConnection` in `packages/web/src/shared/api/events-hub.ts` to: (1) resolve the canonical event-type list from the shared helper (T-007), (2) call `connection.invoke('SetSubscriptionsAsync', [...EVENT_TYPES])` after the `connection.start()` promise resolves, (3) re-invoke the same call from the SignalR `onreconnected` callback. Failures in `invoke` should log a warning but not tear down the connection. Also register an `OnTranscriptEvent` SignalR handler that forwards transcript envelopes into a new LiveTaskProvider callback or store.
acceptanceCriteria: `SetSubscriptionsAsync` is invoked with the full `EVENT_TYPES` list after every successful `start()`
`SetSubscriptionsAsync` is invoked again from `onreconnected`
Invoke failures are logged but do not break the connection
The hook registers a SignalR `OnTranscriptEvent` listener for the new transcript channel
Re-invoking `SetSubscriptionsAsync` is safe across many reconnects (idempotent)
tasks.notes: Use the canonical list from T-007. The transcript handler can initially no-op if no UI surface consumes it yet; the goal is that the SignalR method is registered and ready.

tasks.title: Extend LiveTaskProvider switch with reverse-DNS event arms
tasks.description: Update `LiveTaskProvider` (`packages/web/src/app/providers/LiveTaskProvider.tsx`) to handle the new `com.mohist.*` reverse-DNS event names in its `EventMap` / `AgentDetailEventMap` switch.
